description: This file defines the Csv writer class for PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for exporting spreadsheet data to CSV format with customizable options such as delimiter, enclosure, line ending, BOM, and CSV compatibility features.

classes.name: Csv
classes.description: A class for exporting spreadsheet data to CSV format with extensive customization options, including delimiter, enclosure, line ending, BOM inclusion, separator line, and Excel compatibility.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Csv writer with a specific Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the active sheet of the Spreadsheet object to a CSV file, applying configured options.

methods.name: getDelimiter
methods.description: Returns the current delimiter used in CSV output.

methods.name: setDelimiter
methods.description: Sets the delimiter character for CSV output.

methods.name: getEnclosure
methods.description: Returns the enclosure character used in CSV output.

methods.name: setEnclosure
methods.description: Sets the enclosure character used in CSV output.

methods.name: getLineEnding
methods.description: Returns the line ending string used in CSV output.

methods.name: setLineEnding
methods.description: Sets the line ending string for CSV output.

methods.name: getUseBOM
methods.description: Returns whether BOM should be written at the start of the file.

methods.name: setUseBOM
methods.description: Enables or disables writing a UTF-8 BOM at the start of the file.

methods.name: getIncludeSeparatorLine
methods.description: Returns whether a separator line is included at the start of the CSV file.

methods.name: setIncludeSeparatorLine
methods.description: Configures whether to include a separator line ('sep=...') at the start.

methods.name: getExcelCompatibility
methods.description: Returns whether the CSV is formatted for full Excel compatibility.

methods.name: setExcelCompatibility
methods.description: Configures the CSV output to be fully Excel compatible, overriding other settings.

methods.name: getSheetIndex
methods.description: Gets the index of the sheet to export.

methods.name: setSheetIndex
methods.description: Sets the index of the sheet to export.

methods.name: getOutputEncoding
methods.description: Returns the output encoding setting.

methods.name: setOutputEncoding
methods.description: Sets the output encoding for the CSV content.

methods.name: setEnclosureRequired
methods.description: Sets whether enclosure is required around each cell value.

methods.name: getEnclosureRequired
methods.description: Returns whether enclosure is required around each cell value.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Constructs and writes a single CSV row line, handling enclosure and escaping rules.

methods.name: elementToString
methods.description: Converts a boolean or other type to string suitable for CSV output.
